reason: Edge lives inside the day on 5-min reversal bars at daily S/R levels with first-hour timing and no overnight holds; cannot be approximated on daily bars.

universe.description: Large-cap US stocks with low spreads (e.g. TSLA, AMD, MU, MSFT, META, MSTR)

setup.rule: Identify major daily support/resistance (yesterday high/low or obvious prior levels)
setup.quote: All I focus on is the daily. ... any major support. So any daily high. ... yesterday's high and yesterday's low.

setup.rule: Wait for overextension (multiple same-color bars) into the level
setup.quote: on a 5minute chart, there's just 10 red candles in a row. That's obviously overextended.

entry.rule: Reversal bar (tail bar / elephant bar / wide range bar) at the level that is obvious to the eye
entry.quote: if it gives me, for example, a tail bar, I'll consider a long. ... any reversal bar

entry.rule: Prefer violent move or second-chance entry in gift zone after retrace
entry.quote: if the retracement happens very violently ... wait for the price to come back down

stop.rule: Stop beyond the reversal bar extreme; monetary risk small
stop.quote: short at the tail bar at the low of the tail bar and the stop will go above the tail bar

exits.rule: Target minimum 2:1, aim 3:1+; partial at 2:1 then trail
exits.quote: go for a 3 one, four one, but minimum 2 to one

exits.rule: Trail with MA or bar-by-bar; out by end of first hour
exits.quote: I'm always out of the trades before the hour ends the first hour

sizing.rule: Fixed position size / risk per trade; same size on every setup
sizing.quote: I keep my position size relatively the same since I just don't know which trade is going to be the winner

market_filter.rule: Avoid wide/trending state (20/200 MA separation); prefer ranging/calm markets
market_filter.quote: If the 20 and the 200 get too separated ... be careful going long now. ... Wide state.

ambiguities.issue: Exact definition of 'obvious' reversal bar and 80% removal rule for stops
ambiguities.assumption: Visual discretion on 5-min chart; 80% guideline is optional for experienced traders
